hero.sub: WristVox turns your Apple Watch and iPhone into a Bluetooth remote for your Mac. Dictate, send, clear — one tap away.
how.title: How it works
how.sub: Tap on your Watch or iPhone — your Mac does the rest.
cmd.title: Keyboard, mouse, and more
cmd.sub: 13 commands from your wrist — keystrokes, scroll, and even mouse control. Every command is a single byte over Bluetooth. Instant. Reliable.
cmd.send.desc: Press Enter to send your text
privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.sub: Just a direct Bluetooth connection between your Watch and your Mac. Nothing leaves your devices. Ever.
privacy.noservers.desc: Everything runs locally on your devices
privacy.noaccounts.desc: No sign-up, no login, no passwords
privacy.notracking.desc: Your usage is invisible to everyone
dl.title: Ready to try?
